title: `Flopper.dent` — External Call to Untrusted `bids[id].guy` Enables Reentrancy / Griefing
impact: On the first `dent`, the contract calls `VowLike(bids[id].guy).Ash()` and `.kiss(...)` where `guy` is set by `kick(gal, ...)` — `gal` is the `Vow`, but `Flopper.kick` is `auth`-gated and `Vow.flop()` passes `address(this)`. However, `Vow.file("flopper", ...)` can point `flopper` at an arbitrary address, and more importantly `bids[id].guy` is later reassigned to `msg.sender` (any bidder). A malicious contract bidder can re-enter `dent`/`deal` mid-`kiss`. Because `bids[id].guy` is updated **after** the external `vat.move` + `kiss` calls, a reentrant `dent` observes stale `guy`, allowing double-payment or state desynchronization.
